pages.title: Mixotoxodon
pages.text: The Mixotoxodon ($(o)Mixotoxodon larensis$()) is an extinct notoungulate that lived during the Pleistocene, from northern South America through Central America into Mexico.$(br2)It was the only notoungulate known to have left South America, spreading north after the continents were joined by land.$(br2)Mixotoxodon was a large, heavily built herbivore, larger than its relative Toxodon.
